submission.notes:
Hermes on openai/deepseek-flash, image chi-bench:cm-v51: one harness, one model,
strict single-attempt pass@1 (n_attempts = 1, concurrency 6). Official chi-bench
forwards the task instruction to stock Hermes (max_turns 90, hermes-cli tools, no
domain protocol). v51 replaces that pass-through with one public-record procedure.

The procedure is answer-blind. Prompts, support tools, and turn budgets key only
to the case's own visible chart, public handbook, exposed tool results, and the
member's actual replies. They never read the hidden answer key, rubric, or
solution. Local coding tools stay off. Context compression is 0.75, memory and
checkpoints stay off, and one bounded repair resumes the same session if the
public workflow is unfinished.

Per-domain configuration (all single-attempt, same agent and model):
  - Prior authorization (pa_provider): provider protocol plus compact chart tools.
    Before a case is created, request fields are reviewed against the public order
    or the public documents; unresolved fields come back for another review and are
    not filled from hidden state. Agent budget 120 turns.  16/25 = 64%.
  - Utilization management (pa_um): payer protocol plus intake and audit tools.
    Disposition is required, with no default lane. A true public gold-card check
    rejects nurse_review and md_review in favor of auto_approval.  7/25 = 28%.
  - Care management (cm): care-management protocol, compact chart and evidence
    tools, and a call budget. A non-empty SDoH finding on
    a missing, unknown, or unassessed evidence row is rejected. The evidence gate
    stays off.  7/25 = 28%.

Overall: 30/75 = 40.0% strict single-attempt pass@1.
